przepis.opis_efektu: Replace the background behind the person with a clean off-white chat app UI (like Claude or ChatGPT interface). The person stays cut out in the foreground. A prompt input bar appears in the lower portion of the frame, above the person's head level. Text types itself into the bar character by character: the actual prompt the person is talking about. After the text is fully typed, a send button pulses once (scale 1.0 → 1.2 → 1.0) and the bar sends the message. Background UI should look minimal and professional — light gray interface, clean typography.
